label: New Lead
description: Fires when a lead is created (lead.created webhook). The trigger subscribes its Make webhook URL on enable and unsubscribes on disable.
output: Webhook envelope {id, type, created_at, workspace_id, data} where data is the lead (id, email, first_name, last_name, company, job_title, status, tags, created_at).
notes: SKELETON — part of the Make custom-app spec (see integrations/make/app.json). Build this module in Make's web UI / VS Code from this spec; the endpoint (method + path) is the contract the module must call.
